title: Lien Release and Title Delivery Standard — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contracts
content:
**Status.** The lien on a vehicle financed under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract can be released only when the contract status is paid in full.

**Funds hold.** When the funds that brought the balance to zero were a personal check or an ACH debit, the lien may be released no earlier than the tier's hold in business days after the balance reached zero. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding US federal holidays, counted from the first business day after the paid-in-full date, and release on the last day of the hold is permitted. Payoffs by cashier's check, wire, dealer, lender or insurer remittance carry no hold. The paid-in-full date is read from the contract record.

**Release method.** Where the lien is an electronic lien, it is released electronically to the title state within the tier's electronic release days in business days; where the lien is on a paper title, the title is signed off and mailed within the tier's paper title mailing days in business days.

**Recipient.** The recipient follows how the contract was paid off:

| Paid off by | Release goes to |
|---|---|
| A refinancing lender | The new lienholder |
| A dealer trade-in | The dealer |
| An insurance total loss | The insurer |
| Any other payoff | The customer |

**Alternate address.** A paper title may be mailed to an address other than the address on file only after the customer has completed a signed alternate-address title release request.

**Completion.** Once the release is completed the title status is updated and the account is closed.

## Hold boundary (hypothetical, 10 business days, no federal holiday in the span)

A balance reaching zero on a Monday by ACH debit: business day 1 is the Tuesday, and business day 10 is the Monday two weeks after payoff. Release on that Monday is permitted; release on the Friday before it (business day 9) is not. Had the payoff come by wire, no hold would apply.
